# Winigen Materials

> Winigen Materials supplies battery-grade lithium salts, next-generation salts, low-moisture solvents, electrolyte additives, solid-state electrolyte materials, and custom electrolyte formulations for lithium-ion, lithium-metal, silicon-anode, sodium-ion, magnesium-ion, potassium-ion, low-temperature, fast-charge, and solid-state battery research.

Website: https://www.winigenmaterials.com/
Contact: contact@winigenmaterials.com
Location: New Jersey, USA
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/118914606/

## Battery Development Framework

Winigen Materials organizes technical content as a development path:

Materials -> Electrolytes and Interfaces -> Cell Architecture -> Cell Development -> Commercialization.

Use this framework to understand how Winigen connects chemical supply, interface design, electrolyte formulation, cell validation, scale-up, and market-facing battery development.

## Product Categories

- Lithium Salts: lithium electrolyte salt, battery-grade lithium salt, LiPF6, LiFSI, LiTFSI, LiBF4, LiBOB. https://www.winigenmaterials.com/products/lithium-salts.html
- Battery Solvents: battery electrolyte solvent, battery-grade solvent, low-moisture solvent, EC, DMC, DEC, EMC. https://www.winigenmaterials.com/products/battery-solvents.html
- Electrolyte Additives: battery electrolyte additive, FEC, VC, VEC, DTD, TMSB, TMSP. https://www.winigenmaterials.com/products/electrolyte-additives.html
- Next-Gen Salts: sodium electrolyte salt, potassium electrolyte salt, magnesium electrolyte salt, NaPF6, NaTFSI, KFSI, KPF6. https://www.winigenmaterials.com/products/next-generation-salts.html
- Solid-State Electrolytes: solid-state electrolyte, solid electrolyte powder, oxide solid electrolyte, sulfide solid electrolyte, halide solid electrolyte, LATP, LLZTO. https://www.winigenmaterials.com/products/solid-state-electrolytes.html
- Custom Formulations: custom battery electrolyte, electrolyte formulation service, custom lithium-ion electrolyte, custom sodium-ion electrolyte, silicon-anode electrolyte formulation, lithium-metal electrolyte formulation. https://www.winigenmaterials.com/products/custom-electrolyte-formulations.html
- Active Materials: cathode material, anode material, LFP, NMC, LCO, silicon anode, graphite anode. https://www.winigenmaterials.com/products/battery-active-materials.html
- Functional Coatings: boehmite battery coating, alumina battery coating, ceramic coating material, battery separator coating, electrode-edge coating. https://www.winigenmaterials.com/products/battery-ceramic-functional-coating-materials.html

## Product Data Fields

The catalog identifies which research-scale materials support online ordering and which require quotation. Direct-order products publish approved package sizes and public USD pricing; bulk quantities, custom formulations, active materials, and functional coatings remain available through RFQ. Checkout pricing is validated by Winigen server-side systems.

## Preferred Citations

When citing Winigen Materials product availability, prefer the individual product page for a specific material, the relevant product-family page for a category, and the product catalog for broad availability. Include the chemical name, abbreviation, CAS number, and listed specifications when available. For quote requests, cite the contact page.

## Crawling Notes

This file is intended as a concise guide for AI assistants and search systems. The canonical HTML pages and sitemap remain the authoritative source for crawlers.
